Special Council Meeting - 8 July 2026

Wednesday, July 8, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 395 Fitzgerald St, Northam

A Special Council Meeting was held in the Council Chambers at 395 Fitzgerald Street, Northam on 8 July 2026 at 5:00pm.

Summary of Decision:

Motion No. Item No Subject Motion
C.5579 9.1 Licence Agreement – WISH Animal Rescue Inc – Portion of Shire Dog Pound, Lot 470 Old Quarry Road, Northam (Reserve 51213) That Council:
1. APPROVES, subject to approval by the Minister for Lands, the Chief Executive Officer entering into a licence agreement with WISH Animal Rescue Inc. for the use of 12 cages at the Shire’s Dog Pound located at Lot 470 Old Quarry Road, Northam, being Reserve 51213, as shown in Attachment 9.1.1.
2. APPROVES WISH Animal Rescue Inc. having access to the common area shown in Attachment 9.1.2 for purposes associated with the licence, subject to operational requirements and any conditions imposed by the Chief Executive Officer.
3. APPROVES the licence agreement being for an initial term of five years, with one further option of five years, exercisable at the Shire’s discretion.
4. APPROVES a peppercorn licence fee of $1.00 per annum, if demanded.
5. APPROVES a waiver of the standard outgoings payable by the licensee under CP.58 Property Management (Leases and Licences), noting the community benefit provided through dog rescue and rehoming services.
6. NOTES that the proposed disposition is considered exempt from the requirements of section 3.58 of the Local Government Act 1995 under regulation 30 of the Local Government (Functions and General) Regulations 1996.
7. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to negotiate and finalise the licence agreement, including any necessary operational, insurance, indemnity, maintenance, cleaning, animal welfare, compliance, access and termination provisions.

Wednesday, May 13, 2026 - 05:15 PM - 05:30 PM

Summary of Decision(s):

Motion No. Item No. Subject Motion
C.5537 9.1 2026 Local Government Extraordinary Election

That Council:

1. DECLARES, in accordance with section 4.20(4) of the Local Government Act 1995, the Electoral Commissioner to be responsible for the conduct of the 2026 extraordinary election, together with any other elections or polls which may be required;

2. DECIDES, in accordance with section 4.61(2) of the Local Government Act 1995, that the method of conducting the election will be a postal election.

Annual Electors Meeting - 28 January 2026

Wednesday, January 28, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: Shire of Northam Council Chambers

An Annual Electors Committee Meeting was held in the Council Chambers at 395 Fitzgerald Street, Northam on 28 January 2026 at 5:00pm.

Summary of Decisions:

Motion No. Item No. Subject Decision 
C.5470 5.1 Confirmation of Minutes from the Annual Electors General Meeting held 22 January 2025 That the minutes of the Annual Electors General meeting held on Wednesday, 22 January 2025 be confirmed as a true and correct record of that meeting.
C.5471 6.1 Receival and Adoption of the 2024/25 Annual Report for the Shire of Northam

That the Annual General Meeting of Electors recommends to Council that it ACCEPTS the Shire of Northam Annual Report for the year 2024/25, incorporating the Annual Financial Statements, Auditor’s Report, President’s Report and Chief Executive Officer’s Report as outlined in Attachment 6.1.1.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 17 December 2025

Wednesday, December 17, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Shire of Northam Council Chambers

An Ordinary Council Meeting will be held in the Council Chambers at 395 Fitzgerald Street, Northam on 17 December 2025 at 5:30pm.

Click here to watch the live stream of the Council Meeting

Summary of Decisions:

C.5449 17/12/25 9 Applications for Leave of Absence That Council GRANTS Cr D A Hughes leave of absence from 23 January 2026 to 16 February 2026 (inclusive).
C.5450 17/12/25 10.1 Confirmation of Minutes from the Ordinary Council Meeting held 26 November 2025 That the minutes of the Ordinary Council meeting held on Wednesday, 26 November 2025 be CONFIRMED as a true and correct record of that meeting.
C.5451 17/12/25 10.2 Notes from the Council Forum Meeting held 10 December 2025 That Council RECEIVES the notes from the Council Forum meeting held on Wednesday, 10 December 2025.
C.5452 17/12/25 10.3 Confirmation of Minutes from the Special Council Meeting held on 22 October 2025 That the minutes of the Special Council meeting held on Wednesday, 22 October 2025 be CONFIRMED as a true and correct record of that meeting.
C.5453 17/12/25 12.1 Audit & Risk Management Committee Meeting held on 27 November 2025 That Council RECEIVES the minutes from the Audit, Risk and Improvement Committee meeting held on 27 November 2025.
C.5454 17/12/25 12.1 Audit & Risk Management Committee Meeting held on 27 November 2026 That Council:
  1. BY ABSOLUTE MAJORITY, in accordance with Sections 5.53 and 5.54 of the Local Government Act 1995, ACCEPTS the Annual Report, inclusive of the Annual Financial Report for the 2024/25 financial year; and
  2. BY ABSOLUTE MAJORITY, in accordance with Section 5.55 of the Local Government Act 1995, AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to give public notice of the availability of the Annual Report from 19 December 2025.
C.5455 17/12/25 12.1 Audit & Risk Management Committee Meeting held on 27 November 2027 That Council:
  1. HOLDS the Annual Electors General Meeting on Wednesday, 28 January 2026 at 5:00pm at the Shire Administration Centre and AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to give local public notice of the meeting from Friday, 19 December 2025.
  2. RECEIVES the Independent Audit Review for Major Project AGRN962 - Provision of Plant and Labour Hire for Flood Damage Repairs as provided in Attachment 7.3.1; and
  3. REQUESTS the Chief Executive Officer to provide an update on the progress of the recommended actions to the quarterly meetings of the Audit, Risk & Improvement Committee until all actions are completed.
  4. RECEIVES the update as provided in Attachment 7.4.1 in relation to the progress made towards implementation of the ICT Strategy Plan.
  5. RECEIVES the update in relation to the progress made towards the implementation of the ICT Strategy Plan, specifically as it relates to the Enterprise Resource Planning.
  6. REQUESTS the Chief Executive Officer to present a report to the 2026 February ARIC meeting that addresses the readiness of the Shire to progress with the go live of the finance and property rating modules by 1 July 2026 and the implications and the options if the time frame is not feasible.
  7. RECEIVES the Auditor General’s Report Maintaining Regional Local Roads (Report 3: 2025-26 – Attachment 7.6.1).
  8. NOTES the significant implications for regional Local Governments, including the Shire of Northam, relating to data quality, asset management planning, transparency and funding.
  9. NOTES the Action Plan outlined in this report as the Shire of Northam’s initial response to the Auditor General’s recommendations and that updates on these actions will be provided through the annual Budget Workshops.
  10. RECEIVES the Financial Management Review and Regulation 17 Review as presented in Attachments 7.7.1 and 7.7.2.
  11. RECEIVES the combined Financial Management Review and Regulation 17 Review update as presented by the Chief Executive Officer.
  12. REQUESTS the Chief Executive Officer to provide an update on the progress of the recommended actions in Attachment 7.7.3 to the quarterly meetings of the Audit, Risk & Improvement Committee until all actions are completed.
  13. RECEIVES the November 2025 update as provided in Attachment 7.8.1 in relation to the progress made towards the Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing (PRIS) Action Plan.
  14. That Council NOTES research is being undertaken into the availability and cost of engaging a consultant to assist with PRIS readiness activities for consideration as part of the 2025/26 Budget review.
  15. RECEIVES the progress report on implementation of the Work Health and Safety Action Plan as provided in Attachment 7.7.1.
  16. RECEIVES the November 2025 update on the Shire of Northam Strategic Risk Register.
  17. RECEIVES the August to October 2025 update on the internal compliance check as provided in Attachment 7.11.1 to 7.11.7.
C.5456 17/12/25 13.1.1 Policy Reviews That Council:
  1. ADOPTS BY ABSOLUTE MAJORITY CP.1 Council Members – Training and Continuing Professional Development as provided in Attachments 13.1.1.1 and 13.1.1.2.
  2. ADOPTS BY ABSOLUTE MAJORITY CP.2 Attendance at Events - Council Members and the CEO as provided in Attachments 13.1.1.3 and 13.1.1.4.
  3. ADOPTS BY ABSOLUTE MAJORITY CP.3 Code of Conduct for Councillors, Committee Members and Candidates as provided in Attachments 13.1.1.5 and 13.1.1.6.
C.5457 17/12/25 13.1.2 Policy Reviews That Council ADOPTS CP.11 Alcohol Consumption as provided in Attachments 13.1.1.7 and 13.1.1.8.
C.5458 17/12/25 13.1.2 Request to Lease - Reserve 6305 - Meenaar North Road, Northam That Council:
  1. REQUESTS the Department of Planning, Lands and Heritage (DPLH) to: Amend the purpose of Reserve 6305 from "Water” to “Water Supply and Well”; and Amend the Management Order to grant the Shire of Northam power to lease for a period of up to twenty-one (21) years.
  2. APPROVES the proposed lease terms as follows for Reserve 6305 to Ganelon Nominees Pty Ltd, subject to DPLH approving the above amendments:
  1.     The lease is conditional upon approval from the Minister for Lands under section 18 of the Land Administration Act 1997.
  2.     A lease term of ten (10) years, with an option for a further ten (10) year extension.
  3.    The lessee must undertake all required environmental conservation, heritage preservation and bushfire mitigation activities, and must not use the reserve for any commercial or profit-generating purposes.
  4.    The lessee is to reimburse the Shire for all valuation, documentation and preparation costs associated with the lease, in accordance with Council Policy CP.58 Property Management (Leases and Licences).
  5. The annual rental be set at a peppercorn rate of $1.00, recognising the lessee’s responsibility for ongoing maintenance, fire mitigation, heritage preservation and environmental management.
  6.  All other terms and conditions are to align with Council Policy CP.58 Property Management (Leases and Licences

3. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to provide local public notice of the proposed lease of Reserve 6305 to Ganelon Nominees Pty Ltd in  accordance with section 3.58(3) of the Local Government Act 1995, including disclosure of the proposed lease terms, market valuation, and invitation for public submissions.

       4. Subject to there being no significant submissions being received during the public notice period, AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to finalise       the lease in accordance with the proposed terms contained in this report.
C.5459 17/12/25 13.1.3 Request for Boundary Realignment - Lot 10 (1541) Quellington Road, Caljie 6302 That Council:
  1. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to prepare and submit an application to the Local Government Advisory Board, jointly with the Shire of York, to make a minor boundary change affecting Lot 10 (1541) Quellington Road, Caljie.
  2. NOTES that the proposed change would move the current boundary from its present alignment through the property to the Mortlock River, which is a natural and logical boundary.
  3. 3. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer, if the submission is successful, to negotiate with the applicant regarding the costs associated with gazettal and required advertising.
C.5460 17/12/25 13.2.1 RFT 11 of 2025 - Coates Road Upgrade That Council:
  1. ACCEPTS the response to the Request for Tender 11 of 2025 - Coates Road Upgrade from Protec Asphalt for $895,650.00 (ex GST).
  2. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to make variations (maximum increase of 10% of the contract value) for Request for Tender 11 of 2025 - Coates Road Upgrade from Protec Asphalt.
  3. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to enter into a contract for Tender 11 of 2025 - Coates Road Upgrade with Protec Asphalt at the discretion of the Shire of Northam in accordance with the specifications contained within the Request for Tender documents.
C.5461 17/12/25 13.3.1 Recommendations from the Bushfire Advisory Committee Meeting That the following words be added after the words "Attachments 13.3.1.2 and 13.3.1.3":
"Subject to the following amendments being made:
The Council Member Voting Delegates being increased to two from one".
C.5462 17/12/25 13.3.1 Recommendations from the Bushfire Advisory Committee Meeting That Council ADOPTS the revised Terms of Reference for the Bush Fire Advisory Committee as referenced in Attachments 13.3.1.2 and 13.3.1.3 subject to the following amendments being made:

The Council Member Voting Delegates being increased to two from one.
C.5463 17/12/25 13.3.2 Development Application P25063 - Lot 15 Clackline-Toodyay Road, Clackline - Storage Building for Industrial Hoses That Council APPROVES the development application (ref: P25063) for the ‘storage’ building for industrial hoses, located at Lot 15 Clackline-Toodyay Road, Clackline, subject to the following conditions:
  1. The development hereby approved must substantially commence within two (2) years from the date of determination.
  2. The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the stamped approved plans.
  3. The use of the land is limited to ‘storage’ only of goods, equipment, plant or materials in accordance with this approval.
  4. Prior to occupation or use of the development, a vehicle crossover shall be constructed to the specification and satisfaction of the local government.
  5. No advertising signage is approved in this development approval. Prior to the erection of any signage on the site, a separate development application which includes a signage strategy shall be submitted to the local government for approval.
  6. Only one commercial vehicle shall be parked on the site. This vehicle must not exceed 3.6 metres in height (including any load), 2.5 metres in width and 12 metres in length.
  7. The stormwater shall be managed on-site in a manner so that there is no discharge onto the adjoining properties, to the satisfaction of the local government.
  8. Customers are not permitted to attend the premises at any time.
  9. The display, hire, or sale by wholesale or retail of goods directly to customers is not permitted on the premises.
  10. Outbuildings and storage area shall not be used for habitable, commercial, or industrial purposes without subsequent approval from the local government.
C.5464 17/12/25 13.4.1 Accounts & Statement of Accounts - November 2025 That Council RECEIVES the payments for the period 1 November to 30 November 2025, as listed below:
  • Municipal Fund payment cheque numbers 76 to 78 = $16,756.51
  • Municipal Fund EFT55988 to EFT56245 = $2,533,360.43
  • Direct Debits = $189,851.63
  • Superannuation = $113,107.33
  • Payroll = $606,366.30
TOTAL: $3,459,442.20
that have been made in accordance with the delegated authority reference number (M/F/F/Regs LGA 1995 S5.42).
C.5465 17/12/25 13.4.2 Financial Statements for the period ending 30 November 2025 That Council RECEIVES the Financial Statements, prepared in accordance with the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations, for the period ending 30 November 2025.
C.5466 17/12/25 14 Motion to move behind closed doors That Council, in accordance with section 11.1(i) of the Shire of Northam Standing Orders Local Law 2018 and Section 5.23 (2) (B) of the Local Government Act 1995, meet behind closed doors to consider agenda item 14.1 - Application under CP.29 Rates Hardship as it relates to the personal affairs of any person.
C.5467 17/12/25 14.1 Application under CP.29 Rates Hardship That Council APPROVES the payment arrangement of $50.00 per month for the current owner of A16227 until 30 June 2026.
C.5468 17/12/25 14.9.1 Motion to move from behind closed doors That Council move out from behind closed doors.
C.5469 17/12/25 15.1 Advocacy for Great Eastern Highway Upgrades That Council:
  1.  SUPPORTS advocacy being undertaken to State and Federal Governments to fund and implement further upgrades to the Great Eastern Highway within the boundary of the Shire of Northam to address ongoing road safety and freight movement concerns.
  2.  APPROVES the Shire President advocating to relevant State and Federal Government Ministers to seek funding to implement further upgrades to the Great Eastern Highway.
  3.  REQUESTS Main Roads WA to undertake further safety assessments and corridor planning for the sections of the Great Eastern Highway within the Shire of Northam’s boundary such as intersection improvements, increased overtaking opportunities, and heavy vehicle safety enhancements.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 26 November 2025

Wednesday, November 26, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Shire of Northam Council Chambers

An Ordinary Council Meeting will be held in the Council Chambers at 395 Fitzgerald Street, Northam on 26 November 2025 at 5:30pm.

Summary of Decisions:

C.5429 26/11/25 10.1 CONFIRMATION OF MINUTES FROM THE ORDINARY COUNCIL MEETING HELD ON 15 OCTOBER 2025 That the minutes of the Ordinary Council meeting held on Wednesday, 15 October 2025 be confirmed as a true and correct record of that meeting.
C.5430 26/11/25 10.2 NOTES FROM THE COUNCIL FORUM MEETING HELD ON 19 NOVEMBER 2025 That Council RECEIVES the notes from the Council Forum meeting held on Wednesday, 19 November 2025.
C.5431 26/11/25 12.1 COMMUNITY GRANTS ASSESSMENT COMMITTEE MEETING HELD ON 4 NOVEMBER 2025 That Council RECEIVES the minutes from the Community Grants Assessment Committee meeting held on 4 November 2025.
C.5432 26/11/25 12.1 COMMUNITY GRANTS ASSESSMENT COMMITTEE MEETING HELD ON 4 NOVEMBER 2026 That Council:
  1. APPROVES a grant to Headspace Northam of up to $5,300 (excluding GST) for the LGBTQIA+ Youth Drop In Space.
  2. APPROVES a grant St John Ambulance WA Ltd – Wheatbelt Northam of up to $9,085.51 (excluding GST) for Improving Safety and Preparedness through Starlink Connectivity
  3. APPROVES a grant to the Northam Country Club – Lawn Tennis Division of up to $10,000 (excluding GST) for the Northam Tennis Courts Upgrade Feasibility Project.
  4. APPROVES a grant to the Northam Country Club of up to $4,390.50 (excluding GST) for the Outdoor Furniture Upgrade Project.
  5. APPROVES a grant to the Northam & Districts Clay Target Club Inc. of up to $4,488 (excluding GST) for the Clubhouse Carpet Replacement Project.
  6. DOES NOT APPROVE a grant to the Avon Valley Environmental Society for the Poole Street River Crossing.
  7. ACCEPTS the update on the Quick Response Grant Applications for 2024/25.
  8. ACCEPTS the update on progress with the previously awarded Community Development Grants.
C.5433 26/11/25 13.1.1 Council Meeting Dates 2026

That Council:

  1. APPROVES the Forum and Ordinary Meetings of Council for 2026 to be held as follows, with location subject to change at Council discretion:
Forum Ordinary Location
Nil. 28 January 2026 Shire of Northam Council Chambers
18 February 2026 25 February 2026 Shire of Northam Council Chambers
18 March 2026 25 March 2026 Shire of Northam Council Chambers
15 April 2026 22 April 2026 Shire of Northam Council Chambers
20 May 2026 27 May 2026 Shire of Northam Council Chambers
17 June 2026 24 June 2026 Shire of Northam Council Chambers
15 July 2026 22 July 2026 Shire of Northam Council Chambers
12 August 2026 19 August 2026 Shire of Northam Council Chambers
23 September 2026 30 September 2026 Shire of Northam Council Chambers
21 October 2026 28 October 2026 Shire of Northam Council Chambers
18 November 2026 25 November 2026 Shire of Northam Council Chambers
9 December 2026 16 December 2026 Shire of Northam Council Chambers

2. SCHEDULES Strategic Meetings of Council SCHEDULES Strategic Meetings of Council quarterly, on the second Wednesday of the month in February, May and November and the first Wednesday of the month in August.

3. APPROVES Forum and Ordinary meetings of Council to commence at 5:30pm.
C.5434 26/11/25 13.1.2 Policy Reviews That Council:
  1. ADOPTS CP.9 Communications and Social Media as provided in Attachments 13.1.2.7 and 13.1.2.8.
  2. ADOPTS CP.19 Code of Conduct Behaviour Complaints Management as provided in Attachments 13.1.2.9 and 13.1.2.10.
  3. APPOINTS the Chief Executive Officer, and in their absence or where a conflict arises, the Executive Manager Corporate Services as the Complaints Officer for the purposes of Council Policy CP.19 Code of Conduct Behaviour Complaints Management.
  4. ADOPTS CP.33 Art Management as provided in Attachments 13.1.2.11 and 13.1.2.12.
  5. ADOPTS CP.44 Short Term Use of Shire Ovals and Reserves for Accommodation as provided in Attachments 13.1.2.13 and 13.1.2.14.
  6. ADOPTS CP.45 Temporary Accommodation During the Construction of a Dwelling as provided in Attachments 13.1.2.15 and 13.1.2.16.
  7. ADOPTS CP.46 Disused Motor Vehicles as provided in Attachments 13.1.2.17 and 13.1.2.18.
  8. REVOKES CP.47 Conversion of Class 10 Buildings to Class 1 Habitable Buildings as provided in Attachments 13.1.2.19 and 13.1.2.20.
  9. ADOPTS CP.54 Roof Drainage – Townsites as provided in Attachments 13.1.2.21 and 13.1.2.22.
  10.  ADOPTS CP.55 Signs – Building Permit Requirements as provided in Attachments 13.1.2.23 and 13.1.2.24.
  11. ADOPTS CP.58 Property Management (Leases/Licences) as provided in Attachments 13.1.2.25 and 13.1.2.26.
C.5435 26/11/25 13.1.3 Policy Reviews That Council:
  1. ADOPTS BY ABSOLUTE MAJORITY CP.1 Council Members – Training and Continuing Professional Development as provided in Attachments 13.1.2.1 and 13.1.2.2.
  2. ADOPTS BY ABSOLUTE MAJORITY CP.2 Attendance at Events - Council Members and the CEO as provided in Attachments 13.1.2.3 and 13.1.2.4.
  3. ADOPTS BY ABSOLUTE MAJORITY CP.3 Code of Conduct for Councillors, Committee Members and Candidates as provided in Attachments 13.1.2.5 and 13.1.2.6.
C.5436 26/11/25 13.1.4 Policy Reviews That Council DEFERS the following policies for further review and workshop with Council Members for consideration at the December 2025 Council Meeting:
  1. CP.1 Council Members – Training and Continuing Professional Development as provided in Attachments 13.1.2.1 and 13.1.2.2.
  2. CP.2 Attendance at Events - Council Members and the CEO as provided in Attachments 13.1.2.3 and 13.1.2.4.
  3. CP.3 Code of Conduct for Councillors, Committee Members and Candidates as provided in Attachments 13.1.2.5 and 13.1.2.6.
C.5437 26/11/25 13.3.1 Reconsideration of Council Resolution C.4922 - Relinquishment of Management Order 19 May Street Northam That Council REVOKES Council Resolution C.4922 made on 20 December 2023.
C.5438 26/11/25 13.3.2 Reconsideration of Council Resolution C.4922 - Relinquishment of Management Order 19 May Street Northam That Council:
  1. ADVISES the Department of Housing and Works and the Department of Planning, Lands and Heritage that it does not support the relinquishment of the management of Reserve 40862; and
  2. REQUESTS the Minister for Planning, Lands and Heritage to amend the purpose of Reserve 40862 to Community Purposes.
C.5439 26/11/25 13.3.2 Local Emergency Management Committee Recommendations That Council ENDORSES the revised Local Emergency Management Arrangements (LEMA) as provided in Attachment 13.3.2.3 and 13.3.2.4.
C.5440 26/11/25 13.4.1 Accounts & Statement of Accounts - October 2025 That Council RECEIVES the payments for the period 1 October to 31 October 2025, as listed below:

  • Municipal Fund payment cheque numbers 67 to 75 = $44,778.65
  • Municipal Fund EFT55663 to EFT55987 = $2,668,492.72
  • Direct Debits = $256,544.62.
  • Superannuation = $109,309.45
  • Payroll = $583,268.02
TOTAL: $3,662,393.46

that have been made in accordance with the delegated authority reference number (M/F/F/Regs LGA 1995 S5.42).
C.5441 26/11/25 13.4.2 Financial Statements for the period ending 31 October 2025 That Council RECEIVES the Financial Statements, prepared in accordance with the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996, for the period ending 31 October 2025.
C.5442 26/11/25 13.4.3 Youth Event Support That Council:
  1. APPROVES the waiver of fees and charges associated with the use of the Northam Recreation Centre and Aquatic Facility totalling $5,657.50 for the delivery of 3 youth events in partnership with Bridgeley Community Centre and supported by Northam PCYC during 2025/26.
  2. NOTES that consideration of funding arrangements for these events in future years, including the potential adoption of a 50% shared funding model, will be presented as part of future annual budget deliberations.
C.5443 26/11/25 14 MATTERS BEHIND CLOSED DOORS That Council, in accordance with section 11.1(i) of the Shire of Northam Standing Orders Local Law 2018 and Section 5.23 (2) (B) & (E) of the Local Government Act 1995, meet behind closed doors to consider agenda items:
  • 14.1 - Sale of Land for Recovery of Unpaid Rates, as it relates to the personal affairs of any person; and
  • 14.2 - Community Citizen of the Year, as it relates to the personal affairs of any person.
C.5444 26/11/25 14.1 SALE OF LAND FOR RECOVERY OF UNPAID RATES That Council:
  1. Pursuant to Section 6.64(1)(b) of the Local Government Act 1995, TAKES possession of A2278 - 1 Hunter Road, Muluckine which has rates in arrears for more than three (3) years.
  2. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to dispose of A2278 - 1 Hunter Road, Muluckine, in accordance with the Local Government Act 1995, by public auction with the reserve price set at 100% of the outstanding debt.
C.5445 26/11/25 14.2 COMMUNITY CITIZEN OF THE YEAR That Council:
  1. AWARDS the Community Citizen of the Year to Nominee 1 in Attachment 14.2.1
  2. AWARDS the Senior Community Citizen of the Year to Nominee 1 in Attachment 14.2.2
  3. AWARDS the Active Citizenship (Group or Event) to Nominee 1 in Attachment 14.2.3
  4. AWARDS the Young Community Citizen of the Year to Nominee 1 in Attachment 14.2.4
C.5446 14 MATTERS BEHIND CLOSED DOORS That Council move out from behind closed doors.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 15 October 2025

Wednesday, October 15, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Shire of Northam Council Chambers

An Ordinary Council Meeting will be held in the Council Chambers at 395 Fitzgerald Street, Northam on 15 October 2025 at 5:30pm.

Summary of Decisions

Motion No. Item No. Subject Motion
C.5406 10.1 Confirmation of Minutes from the Ordinary Council Meeting held 17 September 2025 That the minutes of the Ordinary Council meeting held on Wednesday, 17 September 2025 be confirmed as a true and correct record of that meeting.
C.5407 10.2 Notes from the Council Forum Meeting held 8 October 2025 That Council receive the notes from the Council Forum meeting held on Wednesday, 8 October 2025.
C.5408 13.1.1 Amendment to Delegated Authority 11.1.1 – Planning Determinations

That Council, BY ABSOLUTE MAJORITY:

  1. ADOPTS the amended Delegated Authority 11.1.1 – Planning Determinations, as provided in Attachment 13.1.1.1; and
  2. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to make any administrative changes to the Delegated Authority Register 2025/26 to give effect to this decision.
C.5409 13.3.1 Naming of Proposed Roads - DP122617, 186 Chitty Road, Bakers Hill That Council REQUESTS the Geographic Names Committee to name the roads present in DP122617 as ‘Fairywren Retreat’ and ‘Sickle Grove’, as detailed on Attachment 13.3.1.1 and in line with the Policies and Standards for Geographical Naming in Western Australia.
C.5410 13.3.2 Proposed - Amendment to P1129 - Extractive Industry - Lot 1096 Smith Road, Clackline

That Council:

  1. APPROVES the amendment to Planning Approval P1129.1 to allow the continuation of the approved Extractive Industry (Sand and Gravel) at Lot 1096 Smith Road, Clackline for a further 10 years, subject to the following conditions:
    1. The extractive industry hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the stamped approved plans.
    2. This approval will expire and the use permitted by this approval must cease on or before the 15 October 2035, unless an extension is granted in writing by the Shire of Northam.
    3. The excavation area for the gravel extraction is limited to the area shown on the approved plans without prior written approval being issued from the Shire.
    4. The excavation area for the sand extraction is limited to the area shown on the approved plans without prior written approval being issued from the Shire.
    5. The applicant shall comply with the requirements of the Shire's Extractive Industry Local Laws.
    6. Hours of operations and movement of trucks in or out of the site shall be limited to 07.00 to 18.00 hours, Monday to Saturday inclusive, excluding Public Holidays and should be managed in accordance with the approved Noise Management Plan.
    7. The Dust Management Plan approved by the Shire of Northam must be adhered to and followed at all times. Should complaints be received from any adjoining property owner, in relation to dust emissions, dust monitoring equipment shall be installed, at the applicants' expense, and regular reports be provided, in consultation with the Shire of Northam.
    8. All trafficable areas shall be treated and maintained in a manner which prevents or minimises the generation of airborne dust to the satisfaction of the Shire of Northam and in accordance with the Dust Management Plan.
    9. The only intersection/entry and exit point into the extraction area is to be from Smith Road and is to be maintained thereafter to the Shire's specification during extractive operations.
    10. The section of Smith Road used as the haul road is to be maintained to an appropriate standard to the satisfaction of the Shire of Northam, during the operation of the extractive industry. Any damage caused to Smith Road as a consequence of the extractive industry is to be made good, to the Shire's standards and specifications, at the licensee's cost. In order to establish the present standard of Smith Road, the licensee is to provide a detailed road condition report prepared by a suitably qualified civil engineer, to the satisfaction of the Shire of Northam, for that section of Smith Road used as the haul road. The road condition report is to be lodged with the Shire prior to an extractive industry license being granted.
    11. The internal road infrastructure is to be maintained to the satisfaction of the Shire during extractive operations on an ongoing basis.
    12. If at any time the Shire of Northam determines the extractive industry has caused damage to Smith Road, a written notification may be given to the applicant/landowner identifying the damage and requiring it to be made good, in accordance with the Shire's standards.
    13. In order to ensure compliance with the preceding condition, and to allow the Shire to carry out necessary maintenance works prior to the grant of an extractive industry license renewal, a road maintenance contribution is to be paid to the Shire of Northam in line with the Shire’s LPP21 Extractive Industries as amended.
    14. A sign is to be located at the entrance to the property at all times to identify the Extractive Industry operator and a contact name and number for enquiries relating to the Extractive Industry operations.
    15. Remnant vegetation outside of the excavation area is to be protected from the Extractive Industry operations and transport movements at all times.
    16. The site is to be rehabilitated in accordance with the approved Rehabilitation and Maintenance Plan to the satisfaction of the Shire of Northam.
    17. A licensee shall have at all times a current public liability
      insurance policy taken out in the joint names of the licensee and
      the local government indemnifying the licensee and the local
      government for a sum of not less than $20,000,000 in respect of
      any one claim relating to any of the excavation operations.
    18. The licensee shall provide to the local government a copy of the
      policy taken out under the preceding condition, within 14 days
      after the issue of that policy and shall provide to the local
      government evidence of renewal within 14 days of each renewal
      date. On or before 30 June each year, the licensee shall pay to
      the local government the annual license fee determined by the
      local government from time to time.
    19. The licensee who wishes to renew a license must apply in writing
      to the local government at least 45 days before the date of
      expiry of the license and shall submit all documents required by
      the Shire of Northam’s Extractive Industry Local Law as amended.
    20. Prior to the issuance of an Extractive Industry License, the
      applicant shall provide a rehabilitation bank guarantee or bond
      to the value of works required to rehabilitate the area of land as
      determined by the Shire of Northam as necessary to ensure
      rehabilitation of the land to the Shire’s satisfaction.
    21. No commercial activities commonly referred to as 'crushing' will
      take place on the site without the specific approval of Council.
    22. Sand extraction is not permitted to occur below the water table
      of the site. In addition, the dewatering of the site is not permitted.
      Should there be demonstrated evidence that the extractive
      industry is adversely impacting groundwater supplies then this
      approval can be revoked or the Shire can refuse to issue the
      annual licence renewal.
C.5411 13.4.1 Shire of Northam Recreation Facilities Development Plan That Council ADOPTS the Shire of Northam Recreation Facilities Development Plan as presented in Attachment 13.4.1.1 as an informing document for future planning, budgeting, provision and management of recreation facilities within the Shire of Northam over the next 10 years.

  • 14.1 - Application Under CP 29 Rates Hardship, as it relates to the personal affairs of any person, and;
  • 14.2 - Lease of 61-63 (Lot 201) Wellington Street East, Northam - Uniting Church Homes, as it relates to a contract entered into, or which may be entered into, by the local government and which relates to a matter to be discussed at the meeting, and;

  • 14.4 - Rates Recovery - Carlin Heights Subdivision, as it relates to the personal affairs of any person.
C.5416 14.1 Application under CP 29 Rates Hardship That Council APPROVES the payment arrangement of $150.00 per month for the current owner of A12890 until 30 June 2026.
C.5417 14.2 Lease of 61-63 (Lot 201) Wellington Street East, Northam - Uniting Church Homes

That Council APPROVES a new lease for 61-63 (Lot 201) Wellington Street East, Northam with Uniting Church Homes, with the following terms and conditions:

  1. The lease term being for a period of 3 years, with a 2-year renewal option;
  2. The rental being set in accordance with the obtained market rental valuation (Attachment 14.2.1);
  3. All other terms and conditions being in accordance with Section 8.3 of Council Policy CP.58 Property Management (Leases and Licences).
C.5418 14.3 Minutes from the Chief Executive Officer Review and Selection Committee held on 17 September 2025 That Council RECEIVES the minutes from the Chief Executive Officer Review and Selection Committee meeting held on 17 September 2025.
C.5419 14.3 Minutes from the Chief Executive Officer Review and Selection Committee held on 17 September 2025 That Council ACCEPTS the Chief Executive Officer Key Performance Indicator Progress Report from 01 July 2025 to 12 September 2025, as presented in Attachment 6.1.1 of the Committee minutes
C.5420 14.4 Rates Recovery - Carlin Heights Subdivision

That Council:

  1. NOTES the above summary of the ongoing debt recovery process for the
    Carlin Heights subdivision.
  2. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to process a credit for interim and
    back rate charges for assessments A15862 to A15881, with an effective
    date of 1 June 2012.
  3. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to issue interim and back rates
    outside the term of 5 years preceding the current financial year
    prescribed in section 6.39(2)(b) of the Local Government Act 1995 with
    an effective date of 1 June 2012 for the two new assessments that will be
    created for this subdivision.
  4. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to instruct Palisade to provide to
    Optima Funding a without prejudice letter to request payment for the
    newly issued rates and to seek an informal settlement of the outstanding
    debt to the value noted within the report.
  5. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to commence the process of
    changing the basis of rates for Lot 54 on cancelled Deposited Plan 72721
    from Unimproved Value (UV) to Gross Rental Value (GRV)
C.5421 14 Motion to move from behind closed doors That Council move out from behind closed doors.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 17 September 2025

Wednesday, September 17, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Shire of Northam Council Chambers

An Ordinary Council Meeting will be held in the Council Chambers at 395 Fitzgerald Street, Northam on 17 September 2025 at 5:30pm.

Summary of decisions:

Motion No. Item No Subject Motion
C.5392 10.1 Confirmation of Minutes from the Ordinary Council Meeting held 26 August 2025 That the minutes of the Ordinary Council meeting held on Tuesday, 26 August 2025 be CONFIRMED as a true and correct record of that meeting.
C.5393 10.2 Notes from the Council Forum Meeting held 10 September 2025 That Council RECEIVES the notes from the Council Forum meeting held on Wednesday, 10 September 2025.
C.5394 12.1 Minutes from the Audit, Risk and Improvement Committee Meeting held on 19 August 2025 That Council RECEIVES the minutes from the Audit, Risk and Improvement Committee meeting held on 19 August 2025.
C.5395 12.1 Minutes from the Audit, Risk and Improvement Committee Meeting held on 19 August 2025 That Council:

  1. CONFIRMS the minutes of the Audit, Risk and Management Committee Meeting held on 20 May 2025 as a true and correct record of that meeting;
  2. RECEIVES the update in relation to the progress made towards the implementation of the ICT Strategy Plan, particularly as it relates to the Enterprise Resource Planning;
  3. NOTES the information provided in Attachment 7.2.1 in relation to the findings from the 2024/25 interim audit;
  4. NOTES that actions relating to the item in Attachment 7.2.1 have been undertaken;
  5. RECEIVES the August 2025 update as provided in Attachment 7.3.1 in relation to the progress made towards the Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing (PRIS) Action Plan;
  6. NOTES the Independent Audit Review for Major Project AGRN962 - Provision of plant and labour hire for flood damage repairs;
  7. DEFERS Independent Audit Review for Major Project AGRN962 – Provision of plant and labour hire for flood damage repairs back to the Chief Executive Officer for further investigation;
  8. RECEIVES the Financial Management Review update as presented by the Chief Executive Officer;
  9. REQUESTS the Chief Executive Officer to provide an update on the progress of each of the recommended actions to every Audit, Risk & Improvement Committee meeting until all actions are completed;
  10. RECEIVES the August 2025 update as provided in Attachment 7.6.1 in relation to the progress made towards the Regulation 17 Action Plan;
  11. RECEIVES the progress report on implementation of the Work Health and Safety Action Plan as provided in Attachment 7.7.1;
  12. RECEIVES the May to July 2025 update on the internal auditing as provided in Attachment 7.8.1 to 7.8.7; and
  13. RECEIVES the August 2025 update on the Shire of Northam Strategic Risk Register.
C.5396 13.1.1 Lease of a Portion of Reserve 44700, Lot 29082 Fox Road, Burlong - Perth TQ Car Club That Council:

  1. TERMINATES the existing lease with Northam Motorplex Pty Ltd for Portion of Reserve 44700, Lot 29082 Fox Road, Burlong, which commenced on 30 June 2018 and expired on 1 July 2023.
  2. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to execute a new lease agreement with Perth TQ Car Club for Portion of Reserve 44700, Lot 29082 Fox Road, Burlong for a period of 10 years with a 10 year renewal option, subject to:
    1. All lease terms being in accordance with Council Policy CP.58 - Property Management (Leases and Licences), Section 8.2;
    2. Receipt of approval under Section 18 of the Land Administration Act 1997;
    3. A Development Plan being provided by the lessee and approved by Council within 12 months from the commencement of the lease;
    4. The lessee is required to obtain and maintain all relevant statutory approvals, including but not limited to planning, building and health approvals, prior to commencing or continuing any development or operations on the site.
  3. REQUIRES the new lessee to prepare and have approved by Council a comprehensive Development Plan for the site within 12 months from the commencement of the lease, addressing all operational, safety, environmental and compliance requirements.
  4. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to make an application to the Department of Planning, Lands and Heritage for approval under Section 18 of the Land Administration Act 1997 for the granting of the new lease.
C.5397 13.3.1 Proposed Changes to Acknowledgement of Country That Council ADOPTS the changes to the Shire of Northam's Acknowledgement of Country as endorsed by the Nyoongar Cultural Advisory Group at the meeting held 7 July 2025, with the new Acknowledgement of Country being:

“The Shire of Northam acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, Culture and Community, and embraces the vast Aboriginal cultural diversity throughout Australia. On the land of the Ballardong Nyoongar and Whadjuk Nyoongar People where we meet, we acknowledge and pay respect to Elders past and present.”
C.5398 13.3.2 Amendment to the Avon Valley Alliance (Tourism) MOU That Council APPROVES the Avon Valley Alliance Memorandum of Understanding (Amended) 2024 – 2027 as presented in Attachment 13.3.2.1.
C.5399 13.4.1 Accounts & Statement of Accounts - August 2025 That Council RECEIVES the payments for the period 1 August to 31 August 2025, as listed below:

  • Municipal Fund payment cheque numbers 60 to 64 = $29,186.95
  • Municipal Fund EFT55019 to EFT55388 = $2,779,767.64
  • Direct Debits = $157,023.71
  • Superannuation = $100,962.28
  • Payroll = $559,247.48

TOTAL: $3,626,188.06

that have been made in accordance with the delegated authority reference number (M/F/F/Regs LGA 1995 S5.42).
C.5400 13.4.2 Financial Statements for the period ending 31 July 2025 and 31 August 2025 That Council:

  1. RECEIVES the Financial Statements, prepared in accordance with the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations, for the period ending 31 July 2025 as presented in Attachment 13.4.2.1.
  2. RECEIVES the Financial Statements, prepared in accordance with the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations, for the period ending 31 August 2025 as presented in Attachment 13.4.2.2.
C.5401 14 Motion to move behind closed doors That Council, in accordance with section 11.1(i) of the Shire of Northam Standing Orders Local Law 2018 and Section 5.23 (2) (e) (iii) of the Local Government Act 1995, meet behind closed doors to consider agenda item the 14.1 - Rates Exemption Application – 159 Fitzgerald St, Northam as it relates to information about the business.
C.5402 14.1 Rates Exemption Application - 159 Fitzgerald St, Northam That Council APPROVES a rate exemption for land used exclusively for charitable purposes under s6.26(2)(g) of the Local Government Act 1995 to the Wheatbelt Community Legal Centre Inc. commencing on 1 July 2025 for the duration of their lease of 159 Fitzgerald Street, Northam (A11059).
C.5403 14 Motion to move from behind closed doors That Council move out from behind closed doors.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 26 August 2025

Tuesday, August 26, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Shire of Northam Council Chambers

An Ordinary Council Meeting will be held in the Council Chambers at 395 Fitzgerald Street, Northam on 26 August 2025 at 5:30pm.

Summary of Decisions:

Motion No. Decision Date Item No Subject Motion
C.5381 26/08/25 10.1 CONFIRMATION OF MINUTES FROM THE ORDINARY COUNCIL MEETING HELD 23 JULY 2025 That the minutes of the Ordinary Council meeting held on Wednesday, 23 July 2025 be confirmed as a true and correct record of that meeting.
C.5382 26/08/25 10.2 NOTES FROM THE COUNCIL FORUM MEETING HELD 20 AUGUST 2025 That Council RECEIVES the notes from the Council Forum meeting held on Wednesday, 20 August 2025.
C.5383 26/08/25 13.1.1 Lease of a portion of 139 Fitzgerald Street, Northam That Council:
  1. ENTERS into a lease agreement with Danjan Pty Ltd (lessor) for a portion of 139 Fitzgerald Street, Northam comprising 55m²;
  2. SETS the lease term as five (5) years with a further five (5) year renewal option;
  3. SETS the rental amount at $1.00 per annum (peppercorn lease);
  4. NOTES that:
    1. maintenance of the leased area will remain the responsibility of the lessor; and
    2. The lease may be terminated by the lessor with a minimum of one (1) months’ written notice if:
      1. The property is to be redeveloped in accordance with Shire approved plans, and the redevelopment necessitates removal of the wall or use of the leased area; or
      2. The property is sold.
  5. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to finalise and execute the lease documentation.
C.5384 26/08/25 13.1.2 Policy Reviews That Council:
  1. ADOPTS the following revised policies:
    1. CP.4 Legal Representation for Council Members and Employees as provided in Attachment 13.1.2.2;
    2. CP.5 Approval of Annual and Long Service Leave for the CEO and Appointment of an Acting CEO as provided in Attachment 13.1.2.4;
    3. CP.10 Smoking & Vaping as provided in Attachment 13.1.2.6;
    4. CP.15 Public Interest Disclosure as provided in Attachment 13.1.2.8;
    5. CP.17 Council Members Leave of Absence as provided in Attachment 13.1.2.10;
    6. CP.23 Live Streaming and Recording of Council Meetings as provided in Attachment 13.1.2.12;
    7. CP.43 Alfresco – Outdoor Eating in Public Place as provided in Attachment 13.1.2.14;
    8. CP.48 Portable Signs on Thoroughfares as provided in Attachment 13.1.2.16;
    9. CP.56 Records Management as provided in Attachment 13.1.2.18;
    10. CP.57 Complaints Management as provided in Attachment 13.1.2.20; and
    11. CP.71 Independent Committee Members as provided in Attachment 13.1.2.21.
  2. REVOKES CP.49 Political Issues Signs as provided in Attachment 13.1.2.22.
C.5385 26/08/25 13.1.2 Policy Reviews That Council APPROVES a retrospective payment of $330 each, plus travel where applicable, to the Independent Presiding and Deputy Presiding Member of the Audit, Risk and Improvement Committee for the meeting held on 17 July 2025 and 19 August 2025.
C.5386 26/08/25 13.2.1 RFT 07 of 2025 - Newcastle Road - Minor Rehabilitation & Asphalt Overlay That Council:

1. APPROVES by ABSOLUTE MAJORITY amendments to the 2025/26 budget as per the below table to accommodate the award of RFT 07 of 2025 Newcastle Road - Minor Rehabilitation & Asphalt Overlay:

C.5387 26/08/25 13.2.2 Introduction of a 60km/h Speed Zone - Mauravillo Estate That Council:
  1. SUPPORTS the implementation of a 60km/h area speed zone within the Mauravillo Estate, based on the speed data collected and the subsequent recommendation from Main Roads WA.
  2. REQUESTS the Chief Executive Officer to formally notify Main Roads WA of the Council’s support for the proposed area speed zone.
C.5388 26/08/25 13.4.1 RFQ 13 of 2025 - IT Managed Services That Council:
  1. ACCEPTS the response to the Request for Quote 13 of 2025 – Managed I.T. Services submitted by Integrated ICT for a contract term of three (3) years, at the fixed annual amounts of:
    1. Year 1: $149,033.00 (ex GST);
    2. Year 2: $163,943.08 (ex GST); and
    3. Year 3: $175,116.88 (ex GST).
  2. AUTHORISE the Chief Executive Officer to execute the contract for Request for Quote 13 of 2025 – Managed I.T. Services with Integrated ICT, in accordance with the specifications contained within the Request for Quote documents, including provision for up to a further two (2) year extension, to be exercised at the sole discretion of the Shire of Northam, subject to satisfactory performance and budget approval.
  3. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to approve variations to the awarded annual contract value, up to a maximum increase of ten percent (10%) in any contract year.
C.5389 26/08/25 13.4.2 Accounts & Statement of Accounts - July 2025 That Council RECEIVES the payments for the period 1 July to 30 July 2025, as listed below:

  • Municipal Fund EFT54455 to EFT544755 = $1,353,804.26
  • Direct Debits = $30,715.42
  • Superannuation/Other = $227,685.85
  • Payroll = $831,120.14
TOTAL: $2,499,310.86

Ordinary Council Meeting - 23 July 2025

Wednesday, July 23, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Shire of Northam Council Chambers

An Ordinary Council Meeting will be held in the Council Chambers at 395 Fitzgerald Street, Northam on 23 July 2025 at 5:30pm.

Summary of Decisions: 

Motion No. Item No Subject Motion
C.5352 10.1 Confirmation of Minutes from the Ordinary Council Meeting held 18 June 2025 That the minutes of the Ordinary Council meeting held on Wednesday, 18 June 2025 be confirmed as a true and correct record of that meeting.
C.5353 10.2 Confirmation of Minutes from the Special Council Meeting held 09 July 2025 That the minutes of the Special Council meeting held on Wednesday, 09 July 2025 be confirmed as a true and correct record of that meeting.
C.5354 10.3 Notes from the Council Forum Meeting held 16 July 2025 That Council RECEIVES the notes from the Council Forum meeting held on Wednesday, 16 July 2025.
C.5355 13.1.1 Council Plan (Corporate Business Plan Component) Review & Workforce Strategy That Council, by ABSOLUTE MAJORITY, ADOPTS the revised Corporate Business components of the Council Plan 2025/26 as presented in Attachment 13.1.1.1, subject to the following amendment:

- Item 7.3.3 being reflected as needing additional external funding for 2025/26 and 2026/27.
C.5356 13.1.1 Council Plan (Corporate Business Plan Component) Review & Workforce Strategy That Council ADOPTS the Shire of Northam Workforce Strategy 2025/26 to 2028/29 as presented in Attachments 13.1.1.2 and 13.1.1.3.
C.5357 13.1.2 Western Australian Local Government Association (WALGA) - Annual General Meeting That Council:

1. NOMINATES the Shire President and Deputy Shire President as voting delegates at the 2025 Western Australian Local Government Association Annual General Meeting; and
2. NOMINATES Cr J E G Williams as a proxy voting delegate at the 2025 Western Australian Local Government Association Annual General Meeting.
C.5358 13.1.3 Change of Council Meeting Date - September & October 2025 That Council:
1. APPROVES the change of date for the Council Forum Meeting from 17 September 2025 to 10 September 2025.
2. APPROVES the change of date for the Ordinary Council Meeting from 24 September 2025 to 17 September 2025.
3. APPROVES the change of date for the Council Forum Meeting from 15 October 2025 to 8 October 2025.
4. APPROVES the change of date for the Ordinary Council Meeting from 22 October 2025 to 15 October 2025.
5. REQUESTS the Chief Executive Officer to publish the change of meeting dates on the Shire of Northam website in accordance with Regulation 12 of the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996 and on the Shire’s social media platforms.
C.5359 13.1.4 Delegated Authority Register 2025/26 - Amendment That Council, BY ABSOLUTE MAJORITY, ENDORSES the amended Delegated Authority Register 2025/26 as provided in Attachment 13.1.4.1.
C.5360 13.3.1 CP.50 Trading on Thoroughfares and Public Places Policy Trial review That Council ADOPTS CP.50 Trading on Thoroughfares and Public Places Policy presented in Attachment 13.3.1.1.
C.5361 13.4.1 Rates Exemption Application - 260 Fitzgerald St, 53 & 55 Wellington St, 49 Old York Rd, Northam That Council does NOT SUPPORT a rate exemption for land used exclusively for charitable purposes for Avon Community Employment Support Centre Inc. trading as Essential Personnel for the below properties:

1. 260 Fitzgerald St, Northam (A14364)
2. 53 Wellington St, Northam (A12511)
3. 55 Wellington St, Northam (A12512)
4. 49 Old York Road, Northam (A15384).
C.5362 13.4.2 Budget Amendment 2024/25 image.png
C.5363 13.4.3 Budget Adoption 2025/26 That Council, by ABSOLUTE MAJORITY, for the 2025/26 financial year:

1. ADOPTS the following annual fees for payment of Council Members in lieu of individual meeting attendance fees, pursuant to section 5.99 of the Local Government Act 1995, and within the range determined by the Salaries and Allowances Tribunal:
a. President $23,600
b. Councillors $19,750 

2. ADOPTS the following annual Information & Communication Technology (ICT) expenses allowance for Council Members, pursuant to section 5.99A of the Local Government Act 1995 and within the range determined by the Salaries and Allowances Tribunal:
a. ICT Expenses Allowance $3,500

3. ADOPTS, pursuant to section 5.98(5) of the Local Government Act 1995 and within the range determined by the Salaries and Allowances Tribunal, the following annual local government allowance to be paid in addition to the annual meeting allowance:
a. President $45,000

4. ADOPTS, pursuant to section 5.98A of the Local Government Act 1995 and within the range determined by the Salaries and Allowances Tribunal, the following annual local government allowance to be paid in addition to the annual meeting allowance:
a. Deputy President $11,250
C.5364 13.4.3 Budget Adoption 2025/26 That Council, by ABSOLUTE MAJORITY, ADOPTS the following Rubbish and Recycling Fees for the 2025/26 financial year:

a)    Residential and Commercial waste charge                          $   216.00
b)    Residential and Commercial recycling charge                     $   111.00
c)    Pensioner residential recycling charge                                 $     90.00
d)    Rural waste levy                                                                   $   162.00
e)   1500L Commercial Mobile Garbage Bin (weekly)                 $1,263.00
f)    1500L Commercial Mobile Garbage Bin (fortnightly)             $  632.00
g)   1500L Commercial Mobile Recycling Bin (fortnightly)           $1,387.00
h)   3000L Commercial Mobile Garbage Bin (weekly)                 $2,524.00
i)    3000L Commercial Mobile Garbage Bin (fortnightly)             $1,263.00     
j)    3000L Commercial Mobile Recycling Bin (fortnightly)           $2,773.00
k)   4500L Commercial Mobile Garbage Bin (weekly)                 $3,588.00
l)    4500L Commercial Mobile Garage Bin (fortnightly)               $1,263.00
m)  4500L Commercial Mobile Recycling Bin (fortnightly)           $4,161.00
C.5365 13.4.3 Budget Adoption 2025/26 That Council, by ABSOLUTE MAJORITY, for the 2025/26 financial year:

1. IMPOSES, pursuant to sections 6.32, 6.33, 6.34 and 6.35 of the Local Government Act 1995, the following differential general and minimum rates on Gross Rental and Unimproved Values for the 2025/26 financial year for the purpose of yielding the deficiency disclosed by the Municipal Fund Budget in recommendation 6:

a. Differential General Rates
i. Residential (GRV) 11.3500 cents in the dollar
ii.Commercial / Industrial (GRV) 12.1850 cents in the dollar
iii. Agriculture Local (UV) 0.4350 cents in the dollar
iv. Agriculture Regional (UV) 0.4000 cents in the dollar
v. Rural Small Holdings (UV) 0.7250 cents in the dollar

b. Minimum Rates
i. Residential (GRV) $1,159.00
ii. Commercial / Industrial (GRV) $1,159.00
iii. Agriculture Local (UV) $$1,159.00
iv. Agriculture Regional (UV) $1,114.00
v. Rural Small Holdings (UV) $1,159.00
 

2. OFFERS, pursuant to section 6.45 of the Local Government Act 1995 and regulation 64(2) of the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996, a one, two and four instalment payment option, and sets the following due dates for the payment in full by instalments:
a. Full payment & 1st instalment due date 11 September 2025
b. 2nd half instalment due date 14 January 2026
c. 2nd quarterly instalment due date 12 November 2025
d. 3rd quarterly instalment due date 14 January 2026
e. 4th & final quarterly instalment due date 18 March 2026. 

3. ADOPTS, pursuant to section 6.45 of the Local Government Act 1995 and regulation 67 of the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996, an instalment administration charge where the owner has elected to pay rates (and charges) through an instalment option of $10.00 for each instalment after the initial instalment is paid.

4. ADOPTS, pursuant to section 6.45 of the Local Government Act 1995 and regulation 68 of the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996, an interest rate of 5.5% where the owner has elected to pay rates and charges through an instalment option.

5. ADOPTS, pursuant to section 6.51(1) and subject to section 6.51(4) of the Local Government Act 1995 and regulation 70 of the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996, an interest rate of 11% for rates (and charges) and costs of proceedings to recover such charges that remain unpaid after becoming due and payable on 11 September 2025.

6. WAIVES, for eligible pensioners and seniors, the instalment interest, instalment administration charge and penalty interest.
C.5366 13.4.3 Budget Adoption 2025/26 That Council, by ABSOLUTE MAJORITY, ADOPTS the amended Schedule of Fees and Charges for 2025/26 financial year as contained in Attachment 13.4.3.3.
C.5367 13.4.3 Budget Adoption 2025/26 That Council, by ABSOLUTE MAJORITY, in accordance with regulation 34(5) of the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996, and AASB 1031 Materiality, APPROVES that the level to be used in statements of financial activity in 2025/26 for reporting material variances shall be a percentage of 10 or a minimum of $20,000, whichever is greater.
C.5368 13.4.3 Budget Adoption 2025/26 That Council, by ABSOLUTE MAJORITY, pursuant to the provisions of section 6.2 of the Local Government Act 1995 and Part 3 of the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996, ADOPTS the Municipal Fund Budget as contained in Attachment 13.4.3.1 for the Shire of Northam for the 2025/26 financial year.
C.5369 13.4.4 Accounts & Statement of Accounts - June 2025 That Council RECEIVES the payments for the period 1 June to 30 June 2025, as listed below:

•                   Municipal Fund payment cheque numbers 49 to 54 = $25,098.01
•                   Municipal Fund EFT54455 to EFT544755 = $1,801,977.48
•                   Direct Debits = $102,415.88
•                   Superannuation = $96,966.14
•                   Payroll = $538,470.57

TOTAL: $2,564,928.08

that have been made in accordance with the delegated authority reference number (M/F/F/Regs LGA 1995 S5.42).
C.5370 13.4.5 Financial Statements for the period ending 30 June 2025 That Council RECEIVES the Financial Statements, prepared in accordance with the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations, for the period ending 30 June 2025.
C.5371 14 Motion to move behind closed doors That Council, in accordance with section 11.1(i) of the Shire of Northam Standing Orders Local Law 2018 and Section 5.23 (2)(A) & (B) of the Local Government Act 1995, meet behind closed doors to consider agenda items:

- 14.1 - Application under CP. 29 Rates Hardship, as this relates to the personal affairs of any person.
- 14.2 - Chief Executive Officer Review & Selection Committee Meeting held 01 July 2025, as this relates to a matter affecting an employee or employees.
- 14.3 - Chief Executive Officer Review & Selection Committee Meeting held 16 July 2025, as this relates to a matter affecting an employee or employees.
C.5372 14.1 Application under CP.29 Rates Hardship That Council:

1. APPROVES the payment arrangement of $50.00 per fortnight for the current owner of A566 until 30 June 2026.
 
2. APPROVES the payment arrangement of $50.00 per month for the current owner of A15804 until 30 June 2026.
C.5373 14.2 Chief Executive Officer Review & Selection Committee Meeting held 01 July 2025 That Council RECEIVES the minutes from the Chief Executive Officer Review & Selection Committee meeting held on 1 July 2025.
C.5374 14.2 Chief Executive Officer Review & Selection Committee Meeting held 01 July 2025 That Council:
1. ACCEPTS the Chief Executive Officer Key Performance Indicator Progress Report from 22 March to 21 June 2025, as presented in Attachment 6.1.1 of the Committee minutes.

2. ADOPTS the Chief Executive Officer Key Performance Indicators, as developed in conjunction with Hammond Woodhouse Advisory, for the period 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026, as outlined in Attachment 6.2.1 of the Committee minutes.
C.5375 14.2 Chief Executive Officer Review & Selection Committee Meeting held 01 July 2025 That Council, BY ABSOLUTE MAJORITY, ENDORSES the review of the Chief Executive Officer’s performance for 2024/25 and NOTES that the Chief Executive Officer has achieved the Key Performance Indicators.
C.5376 14.3 Chief Executive Officer Review & Selection Committee Meeting held 16 July 2025 That Council RECEIVES the minutes from the Chief Executive Officer Review & Selection Committee meeting held on 16 July 2025.
C.5377 14.3 Chief Executive Officer Review & Selection Committee Meeting held 16 July 2025 That Council APPROVES an increase of the Chief Executive Officer’s Total Remuneration Package (TRP) of 3.5%, bringing the TRP for 2025/26 to $328,519 per annum effective from 1 July 2025.
C.5378 14 Motion to move from behind closed doors That Council move out from behind closed doors.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 18 June 2025

Wednesday, June 18, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Shire of Northam Council Chambers

An Ordinary Council Meeting will be held in the Council Chambers at 395 Fitzgerald Street, Northam on 18 June 2025 at 5:30pm.

Summary of Decisions: 

Motion No. Item No Subject Motion
C.5330 10.1 Confirmation of Minutes from the Ordinary Council Meeting held 28 May 2025 That the minutes of the Ordinary Council meeting held on Wednesday, 28 May 2025 be confirmed as a true and correct record of that meeting.
C.5331 10.2 Notes from the Council Forum Meeting held 11 June 2025 That Council RECEIVES the notes from the Council Forum meeting held on Wednesday, 11 June 2025.
C.5332 12.1 Audit & Risk Management Committee Meeting held 20 May 2025 That Council RECEIVES the minutes from the Audit & Risk Management Committee meeting held on 20 May 2025.
C.5333 12.1 Audit & Risk Management Committee Meeting held 20 May 2025 That Council:

1. CONFIRMS the minutes of the Audit & Risk Management Committee Meeting held on 18 February 2025 as a true and correct record of that meeting.

2. RECEIVES the update as provided in Attachment 7.1.1 in relation to the progress made towards implementation of the ICT Strategy Plan.

3. NOTES the update regarding Rates debt and Sundry debt and associated recovery actions being pursued as outlined in confidential Attachment 7.2.1.

4. RECEIVES the progress report on implementation of the Work Health and Safety Action Plan as provided in Attachment 7.3.1.

5. RECEIVES the May 2025 update as provided in Attachment 7.4.1 in relation to the progress made towards the Regulation 17 Action Plan.

6. ADOPTS the revised Risk Management Policy as per Attachment 7.5.2.

7. APPROVES the Risk Management Framework as per Attachment 7.5.3.

8. ENDORSES the updated Strategic Risk Register as per Attachment 7.5.4.

9. NOTES that the Strategic Risk Register will be reported quarterly through the Audit and Risk Management Committee.

10. RECEIVES the January to April 2025 update on the internal auditing as provided in Attachment 7.6.1.

11. RECEIVES the May 2025 update as provided in Attachment 7.7.1 in relation to the progress made towards the Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing (PRIS) Action Plan.

12. NOTES the information contained in Attachment 7.8.1, 7.8.2 and 7.8.3 in relation to the 2024/25 audit to be conducted by Dry Kirkness on behalf of the Office of the Auditor General.
C.5334 13.1.1 Adoption of CP.61 Privacy, Information Handling and Breach of Information Policy That Council ADOPTS Policy CP.61 Privacy, Information Handling and Breach of Information, as provided in Attachment 13.1.1.1 to this report.
C.5335 13.1.2 Request for Rent Waiver – Lease Agreement for a Portion of 2 Grey Street, Northam That Council APPROVES a waiver of $1,950 (exc. GST) being one month’s rent payable under the lease agreement with Northam Entertainment Group (trading as Terra Mare), in accordance with section 6.12(1)(b) of the Local Government Act 1995, due to building maintenance issues that has limited the use of the premises.
C.5336 13.3.1 Development Application P25036 - Expansion of Peak Power Plant That Council APPROVES the development application (ref: P25036) for the expansion of the existing peak power plant at Lot 9004 Leeming Road, Grass Valley, subject to the following conditions:

a) The development hereby approved must substantially commence within two (2) years from the date of determination.
 
b) The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the stamped approved plans (and drawings).

c) Prior to occupation or use of the development, a vehicle crossover shall be constructed to the specification and satisfaction of the Local Government.
  
d) No advertising signage is approved in this development approval. Prior to the erection of any signage on the site, a separate development application which includes a signage strategy shall be submitted to the Local Government for approval.

e) Prior to the commencement of any works, a deposited plan must be prepared by a land surveyor and lodged with Landgate to amalgamate Lots 5 and 9004 Leeming Road, Grass Valley. The amalgamation must be completed, new titles issued and provided to the Local Government prior to occupation or use of the development.

f) Prior to the commencement of any works, the applicant is to submit and have approved to the satisfaction of the Local Government, a site plan amendment including an area to be dedicated for use as on-site parking.
  
g) The stormwater shall be managed on-site in a manner so that there is no discharge onto the adjoining properties to the satisfaction of the Local Government.
  
h) Dust shall be managed to be confined to the site to the satisfaction of, and as directed by the Local Government.
C.5337 13.3.2 Walk of Fame Inductees That Council:

1.  INDUCTS the following nominees to the Shire of Northam Walk of Fame in 2025 as per confidential Attachment 13.3.2.2:
   a) Nominee 1
   b) Nominee 8
   c) Nominee 9
   d) Nominee 20
   e) Nominee 22

2. NOTES that the next steps will include ordering of the plaques and plinths, development of the QR codes and Shire’s webpage for the Walk of Fame inductees, public announcement of the inductees and arrangement of an appropriate celebratory event.
C.5338 13.3.3 Development & Community Services Policies That Council ADOPTS the following Policies:

1. CP.32 Community Grants Program as per Attachment 13.3.3.2, subject to the following amendment:

a) Paragraph 1 in the table for "Bright Ideas Grant", under "Grant Frequency" be amended to:
i. "Application rounds are assessed four times a year:"

2. CP.70 Donations, Sponsorship & Allocations as per Attachment 13.3.3.4.
C.5339 13.4.1 Fees and Charges 2025/26 That Council, BY ABSOLUTE MAJORITY, ADOPTS the Schedule of Fees and Charges 2025/26 contained in Attachment 13.4.1.1, to take effect from 1 July 2025.
C.5340 13.4.2 Advertising of 2025/26 Differential Rates image.png
C.5341 13.4.3 Accounts & Statement of Accounts - May 2025 That Council RECEIVES the payments for the period 1 May to 31 May 2025, as listed below:

•                   Municipal Fund payment cheque numbers 43 - 48 = $118,251.96
•                   Municipal Fund EFT54096 to EFT54454 = $1,906,699.58
•                   Direct Debits = $35,541.23
•                   Superannuation = $97,531.88
•                   Payroll = $552,751.71

TOTAL: $2,710,776.36

that have been made in accordance with the delegated authority reference number (M/F/F/Regs LGA 1995 S5.42).
C.5342 13.4.4 Financial Statements for the period ending 31 May 2025 That Council RECEIVES the Financial Statements, prepared in accordance with the Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations, for the period ending 31 May 2025.
C.5343 14 Motion to move behind closed doors That Council, in accordance with section 11.1(i) of the Shire of Northam Standing Orders Local Law 2018 and Section 5.23 (2) (c) of the Local Government Act 1995, meet behind closed doors to consider agenda items:

- 14.1 - Disposal of a portion of 33 Wellington Street, Northam, as it relates to a contract entered into, or which may be entered into, by the local government.
- 14.2 - Amendment of a Reserve Purpose and Grant of Lease for a Car Park – Reserve 27147, 392 Fitzgerald Street West, Northam, as it relates to a contract entered into, or which may be entered into, by the local government.
C.5344 14.1 Disposal of a portion of 33 Wellington Street, Northam That Council:

1. ENDORSES the disposal of a portion of 33 Wellington Street, Northam as highlighted on Attachment 14.1.3, through private treaty to Jupiter Health and Medical Services Limited for $400,000 plus GST, subject to:

a. The successful completion of a subdivision to excise the land that is the subject of the sale;
b. The Shire of Northam shall be responsible for all costs associated with the subdivision process;
c. Each party shall bear their own legal and settlement costs relating to the transaction;
d. A caveat be registered on the Certificate of Title for the retained portion of 33 Wellington Street, Northam in favour of Jupiter Health and Medical Services Limited, to provide for shared access and use of infrastructure (car park).

2. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to:
a. Give local public notice of the proposed disposition in accordance with Section 3.58(3) of the Local Government Act 1995, including details of the proposed purchaser, consideration and market valuation.
b. Conclude the sale following the close of the public submission period, provided no submissions are received that require further consideration by Council.

3. NOTES that if any public submissions are received objecting to the proposed disposition, the matter will be referred back to Council for further consideration.

4. INCLUDES an allocation of $13,000 for consideration in the 2025/26 budget for the subdivision and disposal costs associated with the disposal.
C.5345 14.2 Amendment of Reserve Purpose and Grant of Lease for a Car Park - Reserve 27147, 392 Fitzgerald Street West, Northam That Council:

1. REQUESTS the Minister for Lands to:
a. Amend the purpose of Reserve 27147 to include “Car Parking”; and
b. Approve the proposed lease of Reserve 27147 under Section 18 of the Land Administration Act 1997;

2. APPROVES the lease of Reserve 27147 to the adjoining landowner of 380 Fitzgerald Street West, Northam for a term of five (5) years, with a further five (5) year renewal option, subject to the following conditions:
a. The Minister for Lands amending the reserve purpose and approving the lease under Section 18 of the Land Administration Act 1997;
b. Development Approval being obtained within 12 months from the commencement of the lease for the proposed car park, including any required stormwater management measures to protect the Shire's drainage infrastructure;
c. The rental be set in accordance with market value;
d. The costs to undertake the market valuation being the responsibility of the lessee;
e. Public advertising of the proposed lease in accordance with Section 3.58 of the Local Government Act 1995, and no submissions being received during the submission period;
f. All costs associated with the construction, approvals, and establishment of the car park being borne by the lessee; and
g. The ongoing maintenance and operational costs of the car park being the full responsibility of the lessee for the duration of the lease.
h. All other terms and conditions being in accordance with CP.58 Property Management (Leases and Licences), section 8.3.

3. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to finalise and execute the lease in accordance with the above conditions, subject to no objections being received during the public advertising period.
C.5346 14 Move out from behind closed doors That Council move out from behind closed doors.
